notes.title: Next Fest is over, thank you for your support!
notes.content:
Thanks to all players, the Steam Next Fest is now over and I'm glad that the game demo was able to get over thousand playthroughs and number of wishlists. It's actually a pity that there was supposed to be more content here and more bug fixes for different computer environments, but it was just too much effort to go through to make a game like this, and ultimately it didn't make it in time to catch up with the updates before Next Fest started. But even so, the game has gotten so much attention, and I really thank you all for that.

Theoretically, each game should only be able to participate in the Next Fest once, and the current amount of content in the game is completely unsupportable for a release anytime soon. As of now, so please be patient, maybe a few months, maybe wait a year or even a few years until I'm convinced that the game is worth playing. I would especially like to recommend Outcore, which is also a game with a unique gameplay similar to my game and has been officially released, to all those who can't get enough of it after playing my game.

I'll be updating the demo version on an ongoing basis in the future. However, without the Steam Next Fest, it's not easy to let you all know about demo updates. The good thing is that the game will be officially released one day, so maybe it's better for you to ignore the various edges of the development process and go straight to the final version, so please wait for that day.

If there's anything you'd like to talk about, just do it in the Steam discussion forums.

A short update plan: fixing various bugs, redesigning the game's levels, experimenting with more forms of content, and figuring out how to make music and art.

Looking forward to seeing you in the future with more content for MultiWindows.


（Here are the original articles and I'll post them. I hope there are no mistakes in the translation.
感谢各位玩家的游玩，现在新品节已经结束了，也很高兴游戏demo能够得到上千的游玩人数和愿望单数量。其实也很遗憾，原本这里应该有更多内容，也有更多针对不同电脑环境的bug修复，但去制作这样一款游戏实在是太花费精力，最终没能及时在新品节开始前赶上更新。但即便如此，这部游戏还是获得了那么大的关注，真的是感谢各位了。

理论上每款游戏应该只能参加一次新品节，而目前的游戏内容量完全无法支持在短期内发售。就目前而言，所以，还请各位玩家耐心等待，可能几个月，也可能等待一年甚至几年，直到我确信这款游戏值得玩家一玩。在这里特别推荐《Outcore》，那也是一款与本游戏相似的具有独特气质的游戏，并且已经正式发布了，推荐给所有玩过我的游戏后意犹未尽的玩家。

在未来，我会持续性的更新demo版本。不过，没有了Steam新品节，想让各位知道demo版本更新不是件容易事。好在游戏迟早有一天会正式发布，或许让各位忽略开发过程中的各种边角料，直奔那最后的版本才好，还请各位等待那一天。

如果有任何希望交流的，直接在Steam讨论区交流即可。

简短的更新计划：修复各种bug，重新设计游戏关卡，尝试更多的内容形式，想办法制作音乐和美术。

期待未来，《多元窗口》能有更多内容与你相见。）

notes.title: Folder Name Fix
notes.content:
Previously the installation folder name for the Demo version of the game was incorrectly set, resulting in the game's installation folder name containing Chinese.
This caused some parts of the game to not work properly, and I have now removed the Chinese.
If you have already installed the Demo version of the game, please reinstall it again to take effect the changes to the game folder (or just delete the Chinese from the folder and start the game from the game directory).

Translated with DeepL.com

notes.title: Early demo version now available
notes.content:
This demo version was also entered into the Steam Next Festival, although in theory this wasn't a good choice, after all, this version is meaty and rough right now.
But I'm a personal liberal game developer, I don't really like to follow any theories, it's my vision to get people to play this game earlier.
Of course, I'll keep up with subsequent updates, and I'll try to update the demo version over time, updating the demo game once I've saved up a sufficient wave of content and continuing to refine the official version in the meantime.

I'm not sure if the code for this game will work properly on a player's computer, so feel free to contact me if you run into any problems.
I can be found either through reviews, Steam discussions, or my personal social media accounts. ( I haven't got x or discord account, maybe contect me on itchio )

* translate by DeepL

notes.title: Very preemptive beta play notes 非常抢先的测试版本游玩注意事项
notes.content:
This version of the game is an early playtest and only those who have received an activation serial number will have the opportunity to play this version of the game. The number of activation serials issued is very small, and is tentatively intended to be permanent and will not be withdrawn (if something unexpected happens, I will try to re-issue them). If you are reading this, you are indeed a player I recognize and respect, and I have the utmost respect for you.

Because this game still contains a certain degree of bugs, the next is the game play notes:
1, this game does not support multiple monitors, if your current computer has more than one monitor, it may lead to the size of the open window is very small. If you have more than one monitor, it may cause the open window size to be extremely small. Since the developer does not have multiple monitors at the moment, he can't fix this bug, so please disable other monitors and keep only one monitor.
2、Please make sure that the game directory is located in the English path, if you store the game directory path contains Chinese, it may lead to a small bug (specifically manifested as something can not be dragged).
3、Please try to play under Win10/11, we are not sure about the compatibility of the game under Win10.

4, there are still other bugs in the game, for example, when the character turns gray, please click on the window, otherwise the character's collision cannot be executed correctly. If you encounter bugs or encounter obstacles in the gameplay, you are also welcome to contact the developers in various ways.QQ: 1441529822, machine core or B station private letter will be looked at from time to time.
5, if you think it is fun, you are very encouraged to spread the game content, whether it is recommended to your friends or send the game content to social media.
6, all game content, including art, level design and so on, are not representative of the official version of the game content, subject to the deadline and new section, temporarily using a simple program.

（Translated with DeepL）
该游戏版本为早期游戏测试，只有收到激活序列号的朋友才有机会玩到此版本的游戏。本次激活序列号的发放数量极少，且暂定为永久保留、不会收回（如果遇到意外，会试着重新发放）。如果您看到这里，说明您的的确确是我认可且尊重的玩家，在此致以我最崇高的敬意。

由于本游戏仍包含一定程度的bug，接下来是游戏游玩注意事项：
1、本游戏暂不支持多显示器运行，如果您当前电脑有着超过一个显示器，可能会导致打开的窗口的尺寸极小。由于开发者暂时没有多个显示器，因此无法针对此bug进行修复，所以还请您禁用其他显示器，只保留一个显示器。
2、请确保游戏目录位于英文路径下，如果你存放该游戏的目录路径中包含中文，可能会导致一个小小的bug（具体表现为某个东西无法拖动）。
3、请尽量在Win10/11下游玩，暂不确定Win10以下系统对本游戏的兼容性问题。

4、游戏内仍存在其他bug，例如当角色变成灰色时，请点击该窗口，否则无法正确执行角色的碰撞。如果遇到Bug或在游玩中遇到阻碍，也欢迎以各种方式与开发者联系。QQ：1441529822，机核或者B站私信都会不定期看。
5、如果您觉得好玩，非常鼓励您传播游戏内容，无论是将其推荐给您的朋友或者将游戏内容发送至社交媒体上。
6、一切游戏内容，包括美术、关卡设计等等，均不代表正式版游戏内容，受限于工期与新品节，暂时采用简单的方案。
